Clinical questions. Biological insight.

Exploring the skin in a wider biological context.

Dong Hun Lee is a Professor of Dermatology at Seoul National University College of Medicine and Seoul National University Hospital. His research spans skin aging, photoaging, epigenetics, skin–brain interaction and inflammatory skin disease, linking human studies with cellular and animal models, single-cell analysis and high-dimensional immune profiling. He also contributes to collaborative research on medical devices, EBD outcome assessment and skin-image analysis.

He earned his MD, MS and PhD at Seoul National University and completed dermatology residency training at Seoul National University Hospital. He also earned an MBA focused on medical device innovation management at Dongguk Business School, Dongguk University. He has served as Professor since 2023 and as Editor-in-Chief of Experimental Dermatology since 2026.

He has served as Vice President of the Medical Research Center at Seoul National University since January 2026, and as Director of the Translational Medicine Research Institute at SNUH’s Biomedical Research Institute since June 2026.
